# Flight Shade

> Choose a left or right airplane window seat for shade, sunshine, sunrise or sunset.

## App
- [한국어](https://yheun03.github.io/flight-shade/)
- [English](https://yheun03.github.io/flight-shade/en/)

## How it works
- Enter IATA airport codes, the departure airport's local date and time, and flight duration.
- Select shade, sun, sunrise or sunset. Results update automatically.
- Sunrise and sunset times use the departure airport's IANA time zone, including daylight saving time.
- SunCalc solar positions are sampled along a great-circle route at an estimated altitude.
- Sunrise and sunset seat recommendations use the sun's direction at that event. If there is no event, the app says so.
- Weather, actual air traffic routing, aircraft attitude and window geometry are not included.
- Shared query parameters: from, to, date, time, duration, preference.

## Sources
- [SunCalc 1.9.0](https://github.com/mourner/suncalc/tree/v1.9.0)
- [Airport coordinates and time zones](https://github.com/mwgg/Airports)
- [Project](https://github.com/yheun03/flight-shade)
